"""Explicit continuation of an owned cancelled study; frozen fitting sources."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from core import jpeg_study as study
from core import jpeg_study_data as data
from core import jpeg_study_segments as segments
from core import jpeg_study_state as state
from core import jpeg_study_views as views
from core.jpeg_scale import identity
from core.jpeg_timing import write_document
from core.srnet_checkpoint import MAX_BYTES, PARAMETERS
from core.srnet_stream import document, regular_open

SCHEMA = "jpeg-owned-continuation-v1"


def digest(path):
    with regular_open(path) as stream:
        raw = stream.read(65537)
    if len(raw) > 65536:
        raise ValueError("continuation metadata exceeds bounds")
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def prepare(plan, sources, *, torch_version):
    """Validate all inherited evidence before opening any fresh GPU worker."""
    if (not isinstance(plan, dict) or set(plan) != {
        "schema_version", "parent", "parent_report_sha256", "config", "config_sha256",
        "segments",
    } or plan["schema_version"] != SCHEMA):
        raise ValueError("continuation plan schema invalid")
    if any(not isinstance(plan[k], str) or not plan[k] for k in ("parent", "config")):
        raise ValueError("continuation private paths invalid")
    parent = Path(plan["parent"])
    prior = document(parent / "report.json", plan["parent_report_sha256"])
    config = document(Path(plan["config"]), plan["config_sha256"])
    spent = prior.get("seconds")
    if (prior.get("schema_version") != "jpeg-learning-study-v1"
        or prior.get("action") != "controls" or prior.get("status") != "cancelled"
        or prior.get("reason") != "user_cancelled"
        or prior.get("source_sha256") != sources
        or prior.get("config_sha256") != plan["config_sha256"]
        or prior.get("accuracy_qualification") != "unavailable"
        or prior.get("deployed") is not False
        or set(config) != {"schema_version", "action", "root", "manifest_sha256",
                           "audit", "audit_sha256", "execution_mode"}
        or config.get("schema_version") != "jpeg-study-config-v1"
        or config.get("action") != "controls"
        or config.get("execution_mode") != segments.MODE
        or type(spent) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(spent)
        or not 0 <= spent < segments.CONTROLS_SECONDS):
        raise ValueError("continuation parent/source/config/budget mismatch")
    manifest = document(Path(config["root"]) / "manifest.json", config["manifest_sha256"])
    data.validate_manifest(manifest)
    proof = document(Path(config["audit"]), config["audit_sha256"])
    if (manifest.get("schema_version") != views.SCHEMA
        or proof.get("schema_version") != "jpeg-study-independent-audit-v2"
        or proof.get("status") != "completed" or proof.get("source_sha256") != sources
        or proof.get("manifest_sha256") != config["manifest_sha256"]
        or proof.get("representation") != views.contract()
        or proof.get("idct_rows") != {r: len(v) for r, v in manifest["samples"].items()}
        or proof.get("idct_views") != {r: 5 * len(v) for r, v in manifest["samples"].items()}
        or manifest["originals_per_source"] != {"fit": 256, "development": 64}):
        raise ValueError("continuation independent audit mismatch")
    inherited = plan["segments"]
    ordered = [(a, s, stop) for s in study.SEEDS for a in study.ARMS
               for stop in (16384, 32768)]
    if not isinstance(inherited, list) or not 1 <= len(inherited) < len(ordered):
        raise ValueError("continuation inherited prefix invalid")
    cached: dict[tuple[str, int, int], dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for entry, expected in zip(inherited, ordered, strict=False):
        required = {
            "arm", "seed", "stop_rows", "receipt_sha256"
        } | ({"trial_sha256"} if expected[2] == 32768 else set())
        if (not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != required
            or type(entry["seed"]) is not int or type(entry["stop_rows"]) is not int
            or (entry["arm"], entry["seed"], entry["stop_rows"]) != expected):
            raise ValueError("continuation must inherit an exact owned prefix")
        arm, seed, stop = expected
        phase = stop // 16384 - 1
        receipt_path = parent / f"{arm}-{seed}" / f"receipt-{stop}.json"
        value = document(receipt_path, entry["receipt_sha256"])
        rows = value.get("recipe", {}).get("rows")
        recipe = study.recipe(arm, seed, rows, representation=views.FIVE)
        binding = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({
            "recipe": recipe, "manifest_sha256": config["manifest_sha256"],
            "sources": sources, "torch_version": torch_version,
        }, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        checks = value.get("checkpoints")
        if (value.get("status") != ("checkpointed" if phase == 0 else "completed")
            or value.get("source_sha256") != sources or value.get("recipe") != recipe
            or value.get("binding") != binding
            or value.get("manifest_sha256") != config["manifest_sha256"]
            or value.get("execution", {}).get("device") != "cuda:0"
            or value.get("execution", {}).get("torch_version") != torch_version
            or value.get("execution", {}).get("cpu_fallback") is not False
            or value.get("presented_rows") != stop
            or value.get("resumed_from_rows") != phase * 16384
            or value.get("optimizer_updates") != 16384 // rows
            or value.get("total_optimizer_updates") != stop // rows
            or value.get("real_gpu_segment") is not True
            or value.get("real_gpu_fit") is not bool(phase)
            or value.get("accuracy_qualification") != "unavailable"
            or value.get("deployed") is not False
            or not isinstance(checks, list) or len(checks) != 1
            or not isinstance(checks[0], dict)
            or checks[0].get("path") != f"rows-{stop}.npz"
            or checks[0].get("presented_rows") != stop):
            raise ValueError("continuation inherited receipt binding invalid")
        for key in ("initial_learned_sha256", "schedule_sha256"):
            identity(value.get(key))
        for key in ("seconds", "mean_cross_entropy"):
            number = value.get(key)
            if type(number) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(number) or number < 0:
                raise ValueError("continuation inherited numeric receipt invalid")
        if phase == 0 and ("scores" in value or "cells" in value):
            raise ValueError("continuation partial receipt cannot contain evaluation")
        if phase and not isinstance(value.get("scores"), list):
            raise ValueError("continuation complete receipt requires evaluation")
        path = parent / f"{arm}-{seed}" / f"segment-{phase}" / checks[0]["path"]
        snapshot = state.load(path, checks[0]["sha256"], binding)
        if (snapshot["metadata"]["presented_rows"] != stop or any(
            float(snapshot["arrays"][f"optimizer/{name}/step"]) != stop // rows
            for name in PARAMETERS
        )):
            raise ValueError("continuation snapshot exposure/batch mismatch")
        if phase:
            first = cached[(arm, seed, 16384)]["value"]
            if any(value[k] != first[k] for k in ("binding", "initial_learned_sha256")):
                raise ValueError("continuation inherited halves differ")
            if f"trial-{arm}-{seed}.json" not in prior.get("trial_reports", []):
                raise ValueError("continuation complete trial not owned by parent")
            trial = document(parent / f"trial-{arm}-{seed}.json", entry["trial_sha256"])
            if (trial.get("status") != "completed" or trial.get("arm") != arm
                or trial.get("seed") != seed or trial.get("execution_mode") != segments.MODE
                or any(trial.get(k) != value.get(k) for k in (
                    "source_sha256", "binding", "recipe", "scores", "schedule_sha256",
                    "initial_learned_sha256", "presented_rows", "total_optimizer_updates",
                ))):
                raise ValueError("continuation complete parent trial mismatch")
        cached[expected] = {"value": value, "path": path,
                            "receipt_sha256": entry["receipt_sha256"]}
    if sum(c["value"]["seconds"] for c in cached.values()) > spent:
        raise ValueError("continuation prior budget omits inherited computation")
    return config, manifest, prior, cached


def execute(plan, out, *, sources, torch_version, launch, probe,
            current_sources, controller_sources, current_controller_sources,
            clock=time.monotonic):
    """Replay verified owned receipts, train only missing halves, retain budget."""
    started = clock()
    config, manifest, prior, cached = prepare(plan, sources, torch_version=torch_version)
    for protected in (Path(plan["parent"]), Path(config["root"])):
        if out.absolute().is_relative_to(protected.absolute()):
            raise ValueError("continuation output cannot modify parent or dataset")
    data.fresh(out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    spent = prior["seconds"]
    trials: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    capacities: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    report = {"schema_version": "jpeg-learning-study-v1", "action": "controls",
              "source_sha256": sources, "controller_sha256": controller_sources,
              "config_sha256": plan["config_sha256"], "execution_mode": segments.MODE,
              "manifest_sha256": config["manifest_sha256"],
              "audit_sha256": config["audit_sha256"],
              "continuation_schema": SCHEMA,
              "parent_report_sha256": plan["parent_report_sha256"],
              "prior_controls_seconds": spent, "controls_budget_seconds": segments.CONTROLS_SECONDS,
              "accuracy_qualification": "unavailable", "deployed": False,
              "cpu_fallback": False, "cloud_spending": 0,
              "baseline_stage": "not_started", "adaptation_stage": "not_started",
              "independent_source_evaluation": "not_started", "learning_gate": False,
              "passing_arms": [], "representation": views.contract(),
              "inherited_segments": [{**e, "checkpoint_sha256": cached[
                  (e["arm"], e["seed"], e["stop_rows"])]["value"]["checkpoints"][0]["sha256"]}
                  for e in plan["segments"]]}
    write_document(out / "continuation-start.json", {**report, "status": "running"})

    def remaining():
        return segments.CONTROLS_SECONDS - spent - (clock() - started)

    def cancelled():
        marker = out / "CANCEL"
        if marker.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("continuation cancellation cannot use symlink")
        return marker.exists()

    try:
        for rows in (8, 16, 32):
            if cancelled():
                raise InterruptedError
            if remaining() <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError
            value = probe(rows, min(180, remaining()), cancelled)
            if (not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("status") not in {
                "completed", "unavailable"
            } or value.get("rows") != rows):
                raise ValueError("continuation capacity receipt invalid")
            capacities.append(value)
            write_document(out / f"capacity-{rows}.json", value)
        available = [v["rows"] for v in capacities if v["status"] == "completed"]
        for seed in study.SEEDS:
            for arm in study.ARMS:
                if cancelled():
                    raise InterruptedError
                if remaining() <= 0:
                    raise TimeoutError
                rows = max(available) if arm == "genuine-batch" and available else 4
                if arm == "genuine-batch" and not available:
                    value = {"status": "unavailable", "reason": "no_genuine_batch_fits"}
                else:
                    def phase(payload, phase_out, stop, timeout, *, arm=arm, seed=seed, rows=rows):
                        if cancelled():
                            raise InterruptedError
                        inherited = cached.get((arm, seed, stop))
                        if inherited is None:
                            return launch(payload, phase_out, arm, seed, rows, stop,
                                          timeout, cancelled)
                        value = copy.deepcopy(inherited["value"])
                        if value["recipe"]["rows"] != rows:
                            raise ValueError("continuation current batch differs from parent")
                        phase_out.mkdir()
                        target = phase_out / f"rows-{stop}.npz"
                        segments.checkpoint(inherited["path"], value["checkpoints"][0]["sha256"])
                        with regular_open(inherited["path"]) as src, target.open("xb") as dst:
                            size = 0
                            while block := src.read(1024**2):
                                size += len(block)
                                if size > MAX_BYTES:
                                    raise ValueError("continuation copy exceeds byte bound")
                                dst.write(block)
                        segments.checkpoint(target, value["checkpoints"][0]["sha256"])
                        value["inherited_from"] = {
                            "parent_report_sha256": plan["parent_report_sha256"],
                            "receipt_sha256": inherited["receipt_sha256"],
                        }
                        return value

                    value = segments.trial(config, out / f"{arm}-{seed}", arm=arm,
                                           seed=seed, rows=rows, sources=sources,
                                           recipe=study.recipe(arm, seed, rows,
                                                               representation=views.FIVE),
                                           launch=phase, budget_left=remaining)
                if value["status"] == "completed":
                    baseline = next((t for t in trials if t["seed"] == seed
                                     and t["arm"] == "legacy" and t["status"] == "completed"), None)
                    if baseline and any(value[k] != baseline[k] for k in (
                        "initial_learned_sha256", "schedule_sha256"
                    )):
                        raise ValueError("continuation unmatched initialization/schedule")
                    value["cells"] = study.statistics(manifest["samples"]["development"],
                                                       value["scores"], baseline=baseline[
                                                           "scores"] if baseline else None)
                value.update(arm=arm, seed=seed)
                value["inherited_segment_indices"] = [i for i, stop in enumerate((16384, 32768))
                                                       if (arm, seed, stop) in cached]
                trials.append(value)
                write_document(out / f"trial-{arm}-{seed}.json", value)
                if value["status"] == "cancelled":
                    raise InterruptedError
        winners = [arm for arm in study.ARMS[1:] if all(any(
            t["arm"] == arm and t["seed"] == seed and t["status"] == "completed"
            and all(c["learning_gate"] for c in t["cells"]) for t in trials
        ) for seed in study.SEEDS)]
        complete = len(trials) == 8 and all(t["status"] == "completed" for t in trials)
        report.update(status="completed" if complete else "unavailable",
                      reason=None if complete else "incomplete_required_controls",
                      passing_arms=winners, learning_gate=bool(winners))
    except (InterruptedError, KeyboardInterrupt):
        report.update(status="cancelled", reason="user_cancelled")
    except TimeoutError:
        report.update(status="unavailable", reason="controls_budget_exhausted")
    finally:
        report.update(trials=trials, capacity=capacities,
                      trial_reports=[f"trial-{t['arm']}-{t['seed']}.json" for t in trials
                                     if t["status"] == "completed"],
                      new_controls_seconds=clock() - started,
                      seconds=spent + clock() - started)
        if (current_sources() != sources
            or current_controller_sources() != controller_sources):
            report.update(status="unavailable", reason="source_mutation",
                          learning_gate=False, passing_arms=[])
        if "status" not in report:
            report.update(status="unavailable", reason="continuation_contract_failed")
        write_document(out / "report.json", report)
    return report

"""Bounded, original-disjoint Q75/JUNIWARD study preparation, no downloads."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import io
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

from core import jpeg_float256, jpeg_study_views
from core.jpeg_scale import identity, safe_name
from core.jpeg_timing import read_bytes, write_document
from core.srnet_stream import document, regular_open, signature

SCHEMA = "jpeg-learning-study-data-v1"
ORIGINS = ("BOSSbase-1.01", "BOWS2")
SEED = 20261012
MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024**3
ROW_BYTES = 256 * 256 * 4
SIMULATION = "conseal-2025.11-juniward-bounded-entropy-refinement-v1"


def fresh(path):
    if path.exists() or any(p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)):
        raise FileExistsError("study output exists or uses a symlink")


def originals(root, checksum, origin, reserved):
    source = document(root / "source.json", checksum)
    expected = "boss-development-acquisition-v1" if origin == ORIGINS[0] else (
        "bows2-original-acquisition-v1"
    )
    rows = source.get("samples")
    if (
        origin not in ORIGINS or source.get("schema_version") != expected
        or not isinstance(rows, list) or not 1 <= len(rows) <= 2000
        or not source.get("license") or not source.get("source_url")
        or (origin == ORIGINS[0] and source.get("purpose") != "development covers only")
        or (origin == ORIGINS[1] and source.get("status") != "completed")
    ):
        raise ValueError("study requires licensed development original manifests")
    required = source.get("reserved_manifest_sha256")
    if not isinstance(required, list) or not required or not set(required) <= set(reserved):
        raise ValueError("study reserved provenance is incomplete")
    forbidden = set().union(*(reserved[h] for h in required))
    seen = set()
    eligible = []
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError("study original must be an object")
        digest = identity(row.get("sha256"))
        safe_name(row.get("path"))
        if (
            row.get("lineage") != digest or digest in seen or digest in forbidden
            or row.get("source_group") != origin
            or row.get("split") not in {"train", "validation"}
            or row.get("label", "cover") != "cover"
        ):
            raise ValueError("study original identity/role/reservation mismatch")
        seen.add(digest)
        if row["split"] == "train":
            eligible.append(row)
    return sorted(eligible, key=lambda r: hashlib.sha256(
        f"jpeg-study:{SEED}:{origin}:{r['sha256']}".encode()
    ).digest())


def reservations(bindings):
    if not isinstance(bindings, list) or not 1 <= len(bindings) <= 32:
        raise ValueError("study requires bounded reserved manifests")
    result = {}
    for entry in bindings:
        value = document(Path(entry["path"]), entry["sha256"])
        rows = value.get("samples")
        if not isinstance(rows, list) or not 1 <= len(rows) <= 15000:
            raise ValueError("study reserved manifest is empty/oversized")
        identities = set()
        for row in rows:
            identities.add(identity(row.get("sha256")))
            if row.get("lineage") is not None:
                identities.add(identity(row["lineage"]))
        result[entry["sha256"]] = identities
    return result


def prepare(inputs, reserved, out, *, generator, deadline, fit=256, development=64,
            representation=jpeg_study_views.CENTER):
    if (
        type(fit) is not int or not 2 <= fit <= 256
        or type(development) is not int or not 2 <= development <= 64
        or not isinstance(inputs, list) or len(inputs) != 2
        or {e["source_group"] for e in inputs} != set(ORIGINS)
        or representation not in (jpeg_study_views.CENTER, jpeg_study_views.FIVE)
    ):
        raise ValueError("study selection counts/sources outside limits")
    fresh(out)
    forbidden = reservations(reserved)
    selection: list[tuple[Path, dict, str]] = []
    for entry in inputs:
        deadline()
        root = Path(entry["root"])
        rows = originals(root, entry["sha256"], entry["source_group"], forbidden)
        if len(rows) < fit + development:
            raise ValueError("insufficient study train originals")
        selection.extend((root, row, "fit" if i < fit else "development")
                         for i, row in enumerate(rows[:fit + development]))
    # Verify all originals and decoded identities before creating any output.
    pixel_hashes, byte_hashes = set(), set()
    for root, row, _ in selection:
        deadline()
        raw = read_bytes(root / row["path"], row["sha256"], row.get("size", row.get("bytes")),
                         maximum=1024**2)
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as image:
            if image.format != "PPM" or image.mode != "L" or image.size != (512, 512):
                raise ValueError("study original must be 512x512 gray PGM")
            pixel_hash = hashlib.sha256(image.tobytes()).hexdigest()
        if pixel_hash in pixel_hashes or row["sha256"] in byte_hashes:
            raise ValueError("study original/decoded duplicate crosses selection")
        pixel_hashes.add(pixel_hash)
        byte_hashes.add(row["sha256"])
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (out / "jpeg").mkdir()
    rows_by_role: dict[str, list] = {"fit": [], "development": []}
    tensor_hashes = {role: hashlib.sha256() for role in rows_by_role}
    row_bytes = ROW_BYTES * (5 if representation == jpeg_study_views.FIVE else 1)
    used = len(selection) * 2 * row_bytes
    streams = {}
    try:
        for role in rows_by_role:
            streams[role] = (out / f"{role}.f32").open("xb")
        for root, row, role in selection:
            deadline()
            raw = read_bytes(root / row["path"], row["sha256"], row.get("size", row.get("bytes")),
                             maximum=1024**2)
            pair = generator(raw, row["sha256"])
            if not isinstance(pair, (list, tuple)) or len(pair) != 2:
                raise ValueError("study simulation must return a cover/stego pair")
            pixels = (jpeg_study_views.pixel_batch(pair) if representation == jpeg_study_views.FIVE
                      else jpeg_float256.pixel_batch(pair))
            if np.array_equal(pixels[0], pixels[1]):
                # Reject the whole preparation; never cherry-pick labels/regions.
                raise ValueError("study simulated pair has identical selected inputs")
            for label, data, tensor in zip(("cover", "stego"), pair, pixels, strict=True):
                used += len(data)
                if used > MAX_BYTES or not 0 < len(data) <= 256 * 1024:
                    raise ValueError("study output byte limit")
                digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
                name = f"jpeg/{digest}.jpg"
                with (out / name).open("xb") as stream:
                    stream.write(data)
                encoded = tensor.astype("<f4", copy=False).tobytes()
                streams[role].write(encoded)
                tensor_hashes[role].update(encoded)
                rows_by_role[role].append({
                    "path": name, "sha256": digest, "size": len(data),
                    "lineage": row["sha256"], "source_group": row["source_group"],
                    "role": role, "historical_role": "train", "label": label,
                    "method": None if label == "cover" else "JUNIWARD",
                    "quality_factor": 75, "payload_rate": None if label == "cover" else 0.4,
                    "payload_unit": "bpnzAC", "ground_truth": "embedding simulation",
                })
    finally:
        for stream in streams.values():
            stream.close()
    result = {
        "schema_version": jpeg_study_views.SCHEMA if representation == jpeg_study_views.FIVE
        else SCHEMA, "status": "completed", "seed": SEED,
        "simulation_contract": SIMULATION,
        "source_manifests_sha256": sorted(e["sha256"] for e in inputs),
        "reserved_manifests_sha256": sorted(forbidden), "originals_per_source": {
            "fit": fit, "development": development,
        }, "samples": rows_by_role, "tensors": {
            role: {"path": f"{role}.f32", "rows": len(rows),
                   "sha256": tensor_hashes[role].hexdigest(), "bytes": len(rows) * row_bytes}
            for role, rows in rows_by_role.items()
        }, "decoder": jpeg_float256.decoder_contract(), "output_bytes": used,
        "camera_independence_verified": False, "blind_test": False,
        "accuracy_qualification": "unavailable", "deployed": False,
    }
    if representation == jpeg_study_views.FIVE:
        result["representation"] = jpeg_study_views.contract()
    write_document(out / "manifest.json", result)
    return result


def validate_manifest(manifest):
    schema = manifest.get("schema_version")
    if (
        schema not in (SCHEMA, jpeg_study_views.SCHEMA) or manifest.get("status") != "completed"
        or manifest.get("simulation_contract") != SIMULATION
        or set(manifest.get("samples", {})) != {"fit", "development"}
        or manifest.get("decoder") != jpeg_float256.decoder_contract()
        or (schema == jpeg_study_views.SCHEMA
            and manifest.get("representation") != jpeg_study_views.contract())
        or (schema == SCHEMA and "representation" in manifest)
    ):
        raise ValueError("study data contract/decoder mismatch")
    seen, roles, source_groups = set(), {}, defaultdict(set)
    for role, rows in manifest["samples"].items():
        if not isinstance(rows, list) or not 8 <= len(rows) <= 1024 or len(rows) % 4:
            raise ValueError("study role row bounds")
        for i in range(0, len(rows), 2):
            cover, stego = rows[i:i + 2]
            lineage = identity(cover.get("lineage"))
            if (
                cover.get("label") != "cover" or stego.get("label") != "stego"
                or cover.get("method") is not None or stego.get("method") != "JUNIWARD"
                or cover.get("payload_rate") is not None or stego.get("payload_rate") != 0.4
                or cover.get("source_group") not in ORIGINS
                or stego.get("lineage") != lineage
                or stego.get("source_group") != cover["source_group"]
                or lineage in roles
            ):
                raise ValueError("study pair ancestry/labels mismatch")
            roles[lineage] = role
            source_groups[role].add(cover["source_group"])
            for row in (cover, stego):
                digest = identity(row.get("sha256"))
                if (digest in seen or row.get("role") != role
                    or row.get("historical_role") != "train" or row.get("quality_factor") != 75
                    or row.get("path") != f"jpeg/{digest}.jpg"
                    or type(row.get("size")) is not int or not 0 < row["size"] <= 256 * 1024):
                    raise ValueError("study sample identity/role mismatch")
                seen.add(digest)
        if source_groups[role] != set(ORIGINS):
            raise ValueError("study role requires both declared origins")
        counts = [sum(r["source_group"] == origin for r in rows) // 2 for origin in ORIGINS]
        if counts != [manifest["originals_per_source"][role]] * 2:
            raise ValueError("study original source accounting mismatch")


class Reader:
    """Only opens one assigned-role tensor, never loads a whole corpus."""

    def __init__(self, root, checksum, role, *, deadline):
        deadline()
        if role not in {"fit", "development"}:
            raise ValueError("study reader role invalid")
        self.manifest = document(root / "manifest.json", checksum)
        validate_manifest(self.manifest)
        self.view_count = 5 if self.manifest["schema_version"] == jpeg_study_views.SCHEMA else 1
        self.row_bytes = ROW_BYTES * self.view_count
        self.samples = self.manifest["samples"][role]
        self.deadline = deadline
        tensor = self.manifest["tensors"][role]
        identity(tensor["sha256"])
        if (tensor["path"] != f"{role}.f32" or type(tensor["rows"]) is not int
            or type(tensor["bytes"]) is not int or tensor["rows"] != len(self.samples)
            or tensor["bytes"] != len(self.samples) * self.row_bytes):
            raise ValueError("study tensor identity/accounting mismatch")
        self.sha256 = tensor["sha256"]
        self.stream = regular_open(root / tensor["path"])
        self.initial = signature(self.stream)
        try:
            if self.initial[2] != tensor["bytes"]:
                raise ValueError("study tensor length mismatch")
            self.verify()
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def verify(self):
        self.deadline()
        if signature(self.stream) != self.initial:
            raise ValueError("study tensor changed")
        self.stream.seek(0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        while raw := self.stream.read(1024**2):
            self.deadline()
            values = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype="<f4")
            if not np.isfinite(values).all() or np.any(np.abs(values) > 2**36):
                raise ValueError("study tensor nonfinite/out of bounds")
            digest.update(raw)
        if digest.hexdigest() != self.sha256 or signature(self.stream) != self.initial:
            raise ValueError("study tensor checksum/mutation mismatch")

    def batch(self, indices, views=None):
        self.deadline()
        if (not isinstance(indices, np.ndarray) or indices.ndim != 1
            or indices.dtype.kind not in "iu" or not 1 <= len(indices) <= 32
            or np.any(indices < 0) or np.any(indices >= len(self.samples))
            or signature(self.stream) != self.initial):
            raise ValueError("study batch bounds/state mismatch")
        if self.view_count == 5:
            if (not isinstance(views, np.ndarray) or views.shape != indices.shape
                or views.dtype.kind not in "iu" or np.any(views < 0) or np.any(views >= 5)):
                raise ValueError("study five-view indices invalid")
        elif views is not None:
            raise ValueError("center study does not accept view indices")
        result = np.empty((len(indices), 1, 256, 256), dtype="<f4")
        for position, (target, i) in enumerate(zip(result, indices, strict=True)):
            self.deadline()
            view = int(views[position]) if views is not None else 0
            self.stream.seek(int(i) * self.row_bytes + view * ROW_BYTES)
            raw = self.stream.read(ROW_BYTES)
            if len(raw) != ROW_BYTES or signature(self.stream) != self.initial:
                raise ValueError("study row truncated/changed")
            target[:] = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype="<f4").reshape(1, 256, 256)
        return result

    def close(self):
        self.stream.close()

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.close()

"""Independent bounded Gibbs-entropy refinement, not a payload extractor."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def refine(costs, target):
    if (not isinstance(costs, tuple) or len(costs) != 2 or type(target) is not int
        or not 1 <= target <= 512 * 512):
        raise ValueError("study entropy target/cost container invalid")
    first, second = costs
    if any(not isinstance(c, np.ndarray) or c.ndim != 2 or not 1 <= c.size <= 512**2
           or c.dtype != np.float64 or not np.isfinite(c).all()
           or np.any(c < 0) or np.any(c > 1e14) for c in costs) or first.shape != second.shape:
        raise ValueError("study entropy costs outside numeric/shape bounds")

    def evaluate(value):
        positive, negative = np.exp(-value * first), np.exp(-value * second)
        denominator = 1 + positive + negative
        probabilities = (positive / denominator, negative / denominator, 1 / denominator)
        entropy = sum(float(np.sum(-p[p > 0] * np.log2(p[p > 0]))) for p in probabilities)
        return probabilities[:2], entropy

    low, high = 0.0, 1.0
    if evaluate(low)[1] < target:
        raise ValueError("study entropy target exceeds capacity")
    for _ in range(64):
        if evaluate(high)[1] <= target:
            break
        high *= 2
    else:
        raise ValueError("study entropy target cannot be bracketed")
    for _ in range(80):
        middle = (low + high) / 2
        probabilities, entropy = evaluate(middle)
        if abs(entropy - target) <= target * 1e-6:
            return probabilities
        if entropy > target:
            low = middle
        else:
            high = middle
    raise ValueError("study entropy refinement did not converge")

"""Two bounded, source-bound halves; never qualify an incomplete logical fit."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
import time
from typing import Any

from core.jpeg_scale import identity
from core.jpeg_study_data import fresh
from core.jpeg_study_process import WorkerFailure
from core.jpeg_timing import write_document
from core.srnet_checkpoint import MAX_BYTES
from core.srnet_stream import regular_open

MODE = "bounded-half-v1"
CONTROLS_SECONDS = 6 * 3600


def checkpoint(path, checksum):
    identity(checksum)
    digest, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    with regular_open(path) as stream:
        while block := stream.read(1024**2):
            size += len(block)
            if size > MAX_BYTES:
                raise ValueError("study segment checkpoint exceeds bounds")
            digest.update(block)
    if not size or digest.hexdigest() != checksum:
        raise ValueError("study segment checkpoint checksum mismatch")


def trial(config, out, *, arm, seed, rows, sources, recipe, launch, budget_left):
    if config.get("resume"):
        raise ValueError("segmented controls do not import external resumes")
    fresh(out)
    out.mkdir()
    segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    first = None
    for index, stop in enumerate((16384, 32768)):
        if budget_left() <= 0:
            return {"status": "unavailable", "reason": "controls_budget_exhausted",
                    "segments": segments, "execution_mode": MODE, "real_gpu_fit": False}
        payload = dict(config)
        # Each isolated worker executes one bounded phase; only the parent owns
        # the segmented policy. External segmented configurations cannot resume.
        payload.pop("execution_mode", None)
        if first is not None:
            entry = first["checkpoints"][0]
            payload["resume"] = [{"arm": arm, "seed": seed,
                                  "path": str(out / "segment-0" / entry["path"]),
                                  "sha256": entry["sha256"]}]
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            value = launch(payload, out / f"segment-{index}", stop,
                           min(1830, max(1, budget_left())))
        except WorkerFailure as exc:
            value = exc.unavailable()
        except TimeoutError:
            value = {"status": "unavailable", "reason": "worker_timeout"}
        except InterruptedError:
            value = {"status": "cancelled", "reason": "user_cancelled"}
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("status") not in {
            "checkpointed", "completed", "unavailable", "cancelled"
        }:
            raise ValueError("study segment response invalid")
        if value.get("source_sha256", sources) != sources:
            raise ValueError("study segment source binding mismatch")
        segments.append({"index": index, "start_rows": index * 16384, "stop_rows": stop,
                         "status": value["status"], "reason": value.get("reason"),
                         "seconds": value.get("seconds"),
                         "worker_wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                         **({"worker_execution": value["worker_execution"]}
                            if "worker_execution" in value else {})})
        if value["status"] in {"unavailable", "cancelled"}:
            write_document(out / f"receipt-{stop}.json", value)
            return {**value, "segments": segments, "execution_mode": MODE,
                    "real_gpu_fit": False}
        expected_status = "checkpointed" if index == 0 else "completed"
        if (value["status"] != expected_status or value.get("source_sha256") != sources
            or value.get("presented_rows") != stop
            or value.get("resumed_from_rows") != index * 16384
            or value.get("optimizer_updates") != 16384 // rows
            or value.get("total_optimizer_updates") != stop // rows
            or value.get("recipe") != recipe
            or not isinstance(value.get("execution"), dict)
            or value.get("execution", {}).get("device") != "cuda:0"
            or value.get("real_gpu_segment") is not True):
            raise ValueError("incomplete/non-GPU study segment cannot complete")
        for key in ("binding", "initial_learned_sha256", "schedule_sha256"):
            identity(value.get(key))
        for key in ("seconds", "mean_cross_entropy"):
            number = value.get(key)
            if (not isinstance(number, (int, float)) or isinstance(number, bool)
                or not math.isfinite(number) or number < 0):
                raise ValueError("study segment numeric receipt invalid")
        checkpoints = value.get("checkpoints")
        if (not isinstance(checkpoints, list) or len(checkpoints) != 1
            or not isinstance(checkpoints[0], dict)
            or checkpoints[0].get("path") != f"rows-{stop}.npz"
            or checkpoints[0].get("presented_rows") != stop):
            raise ValueError("study segment checkpoint provenance invalid")
        checkpoint(out / f"segment-{index}" / checkpoints[0]["path"],
                   checkpoints[0].get("sha256"))
        if index == 0:
            if value.get("real_gpu_fit") or "scores" in value or "cells" in value:
                raise ValueError("partial study segment cannot report evaluation")
            first = value
        elif (first is None or value.get("binding") != first.get("binding")
              or value.get("recipe") != first.get("recipe")
              or value.get("initial_learned_sha256") != first.get("initial_learned_sha256")
              or value.get("real_gpu_fit") is not True):
            raise ValueError("study segment recipe/initialization/binding mismatch")
        write_document(out / f"receipt-{stop}.json", value)
    if first is None:
        raise ValueError("study segments missing first checkpoint")
    result = dict(value)
    result.update(execution_mode=MODE, segments=segments,
                  seconds=sum(s["seconds"] for s in segments),
                  optimizer_updates=32768 // rows, resumed_from_rows=0,
                  mean_cross_entropy=(first["mean_cross_entropy"]
                                      + value["mean_cross_entropy"]) / 2,
                  mean_cross_entropy_aggregation="update-weighted_segment_means",
                  checkpoints=[{**first["checkpoints"][0],
                                "path": "segment-0/rows-16384.npz"},
                               {**value["checkpoints"][0],
                                "path": "segment-1/rows-32768.npz"}])
    return result

"""Bounded, unrounded gray JPEG views; no content/label-based region choice."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import os
import resource
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from contextlib import suppress
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

from core import jpeg_float256
from core.jpeg_features import validate_jpeg

CENTER = "center256"
FIVE = "center-four-corners256"
SCHEMA = "jpeg-learning-study-five-view-data-v1"
REGIONS = ((128, 128, 256, 256), (0, 0, 256, 256), (256, 0, 256, 256),
           (0, 256, 256, 256), (256, 256, 256, 256))
ROW_BYTES = 5 * 256 * 256 * 4
MAX_JPEG = 256 * 1024


def contract():
    return {"feature_version": "jpeg-gray-five-view-phase0-unrounded-f32-v1",
            "regions": [list(r) for r in REGIONS], "view_count": 5,
            "cache_layout": "sample-view-channel-y-x-le-f32",
            "training_views": "lineage-seeded-offset-cyclic-per-pair-exposure-v1",
            "inference": "arithmetic-mean-five-singleton-stego-probabilities-v1",
            "color": "native grayscale; not RGB", "view_selection": "label-independent"}


def validate(data):
    if not isinstance(data, bytes) or not 0 < len(data) <= MAX_JPEG:
        raise ValueError("five-view JPEG byte bounds")
    validate_jpeg(data)
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as image:
        if image.mode != "L" or image.size != (512, 512):
            raise ValueError("five-view JPEG requires native gray 512x512")


def reconstruct(coefficients, qt):
    # The existing bounded coefficient validator is reused, not its region choice.
    jpeg_float256.reconstruct(coefficients, qt, 512, 512)
    basis = np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(8)[:, None] * (2 * np.arange(8)[None, :] + 1) / 16) / 2
    basis[0] /= np.sqrt(2)
    blocks = coefficients.astype(np.float64) * qt
    raster = np.einsum("ux,abuv,vy->abxy", basis, blocks, basis, optimize=True) + 128
    full = raster.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(512, 512).astype("<f4")
    if not np.isfinite(full).all() or np.any(np.abs(full) > jpeg_float256.MAX_MAGNITUDE):
        raise ValueError("five-view nonfinite/out-of-bounds raster")
    return np.stack([full[top:top + height, left:left + width]
                     for left, top, width, height in REGIONS])[:, None]


def decode(data):
    import jpeglib

    validate(data)
    jpeglib.version.set("6b")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="jpeg-five-view-") as folder:
        path = Path(folder) / "input.jpg"
        with path.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
        jpeg = jpeglib.read_dct(str(path))
        jpeg.load()
        if (jpeg.jpeg_color_space.name != "JCS_GRAYSCALE"
            or (jpeg.width, jpeg.height) != (512, 512)):
            raise ValueError("five-view native JPEG structure mismatch")
        return reconstruct(jpeg.Y, jpeg.get_component_qt(0)).tobytes()


def pixel_batch(files):
    if not isinstance(files, (list, tuple)) or not 1 <= len(files) <= 2:
        raise ValueError("five-view batch outside limits")
    jpeg_float256.decoder_contract()
    for data in files:
        validate(data)
    payload = len(files).to_bytes(4, "little") + b"".join(
        len(data).to_bytes(4, "little") + data for data in files
    )
    maximum = len(files) * ROW_BYTES
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as output:
        process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - fixed resource-limited module, no shell
            [sys.executable, "-m", "core.jpeg_study_views"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
            stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True,
            cwd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1],
            env={"PATH": os.environ.get("PATH", ""), "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1",
                 "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1"},
        )
        try:
            process.communicate(payload, timeout=20)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            raise RuntimeError("five-view worker timeout") from exc
        finally:
            with suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            process.wait()
        output.seek(0)
        raw = output.read(maximum + 1)
    if process.returncode or len(raw) != maximum:
        raise RuntimeError("five-view worker failed/output bounds")
    values = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype="<f4").reshape(len(files), 5, 1, 256, 256)
    if not np.isfinite(values).all() or np.any(np.abs(values) > jpeg_float256.MAX_MAGNITUDE):
        raise ValueError("five-view worker tensor invalid")
    return values


def main():
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1024**3, 1024**3))
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (20, 21))
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (2 * ROW_BYTES, 2 * ROW_BYTES))
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE, (0, 0))
    try:
        stream = sys.stdin.buffer
        header = stream.read(4)
        count = int.from_bytes(header, "little")
        if len(header) != 4 or not 1 <= count <= 2:
            raise ValueError("five-view worker frame invalid")
        for _ in range(count):
            header = stream.read(4)
            size = int.from_bytes(header, "little")
            if len(header) != 4 or not 0 < size <= MAX_JPEG:
                raise ValueError("five-view worker byte limit")
            raw = stream.read(size)
            if len(raw) != size:
                raise ValueError("five-view worker truncated frame")
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(decode(raw))
        if stream.read(1):
            raise ValueError("five-view worker trailing input")
        return 0
    except (ValueError, OSError, ImportError):
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

core/jpeg_timing.py.utf8:
"""Local, train-only three-origin timing kit; not a detector training corpus."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from core import jpeg_float256, srnet_diversity_sampling
from core.jpeg_features import MAX_IMAGE_BYTES
from core.jpeg_scale import identity, safe_name
from core.srnet_sampling import _buckets
from core.srnet_stream import ROW_BYTES, TrainBlocks, document, regular_open

ORIGINS = ("ALASKA2", "BOSSbase-1.01", "BOWS2")
SEED = 20261010
MAX_OUTPUT = 512 * 1024**2


def select(samples, source, count):
    """Select complete original families by identity, never pixels or scores."""
    if source not in ORIGINS or type(count) is not int or not 2 <= count <= 32:
        raise ValueError("timing selection source/count outside bounds")
    if not isinstance(samples, list) or len(samples) > 15000:
        raise ValueError("timing selection row limit")
    groups: dict[str, list] = defaultdict(list)
    roles: dict[str, str] = {}
    digests = set()
    for row in samples:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError("timing selection requires object rows")
        lineage, digest = identity(row.get("lineage")), identity(row.get("sha256"))
        if row.get("source_group") != source or row.get("split") not in {"train", "validation"}:
            raise ValueError("timing selection source/role mismatch")
        if digest in digests or roles.setdefault(lineage, row["split"]) != row["split"]:
            raise ValueError("timing selection duplicate or cross-role lineage")
        digests.add(digest)
        if row["split"] == "train":
            groups[lineage].append(row)
    if source == "BOWS2":
        if any(len(rows) != 1 or rows[0]["sha256"] != key for key, rows in groups.items()):
            raise ValueError("timing BOWS originals must be unique original identities")
    else:
        for rows in groups.values():
            _buckets(rows, row_limit=6)
            expected = {None} if source == "ALASKA2" else {75, 95}
            if (
                len(rows) != 3 * len(expected)
                or {r.get("quality_factor") for r in rows} != expected
            ):
                raise ValueError("timing quality families mismatch")
    if len(groups) < count:
        raise ValueError("insufficient timing train originals")
    ordered = sorted(
        groups,
        key=lambda key: hashlib.sha256(f"timing-kit:{SEED}:{source}:{key}".encode()).digest(),
    )[:count]
    return [row for key in ordered for row in groups[key]]


def read_bytes(path, digest, size, *, maximum=MAX_IMAGE_BYTES):
    identity(digest)
    if type(size) is not int or not 0 < size <= maximum:
        raise ValueError("timing input byte limit")
    with regular_open(path) as stream:
        data = stream.read(size + 1)
    if len(data) != size or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != digest:
        raise ValueError("timing input byte identity mismatch")
    return data


def write_document(path, value):
    raw = (json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
    if len(raw) > 16 * 1024**2:
        raise ValueError("timing metadata exceeds limits")
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def prepare(
    root: Path,
    bows: Path,
    out: Path,
    *,
    protocol: Path,
    protocol_sha256,
    index_sha256,
    audit: Path,
    audit_sha256,
    bows_sha256,
    bows_audit: Path,
    bows_audit_sha256,
    deadline,
    generator,
):
    """Fresh private output, checksum-bound audits, bounded worker callback.

    The callback must execute the fixed simulation recipe in an isolated,
    timeout/resource-limited worker. No validation image/cache is read here.
    """
    deadline()
    frozen = document(protocol, protocol_sha256)
    binding = {
        "index_sha256": index_sha256,
        "audit_sha256": audit_sha256,
        "bows_sha256": bows_sha256,
        "bows_audit_sha256": bows_audit_sha256,
    }
    if (
        frozen.get("schema_version") != "jpeg-real-timing-protocol-v1"
        or frozen.get("inputs") != binding
        or frozen.get("originals_per_source") != 32
        or frozen.get("seed") != SEED
    ):
        raise ValueError("timing protocol/input binding mismatch")
    source = document(bows / "source.json", bows_sha256)
    proof = document(bows_audit, bows_audit_sha256)
    if (
        source.get("schema_version") != "bows2-original-acquisition-v1"
        or source.get("status") != "completed"
        or proof.get("schema_version") != "bows2-independent-original-audit-v1"
        or proof.get("status") != "completed"
        or proof.get("source_manifest_sha256") != bows_sha256
        or proof.get("exact_identity_overlap") != 0
        or proof.get("decoded_boss_pixel_overlap") != 0
        or proof.get("reserved_manifest_sha256") != source.get("reserved_manifest_sha256")
    ):
        raise ValueError("timing requires bound BOWS original audit")
    originals = select(source.get("samples"), "BOWS2", 32)
    selected = []
    with TrainBlocks(
        root,
        index_sha256=index_sha256,
        audit=audit,
        audit_sha256=audit_sha256,
        deadline=deadline,
    ) as reader:
        for origin in ORIGINS[:2]:
            selected.extend(
                select([r for r in reader.samples if r["source_group"] == origin], origin, 32)
            )
    if {r["lineage"] for r in originals} & {r["lineage"] for r in selected}:
        raise ValueError("timing cross-source original overlap")
    index = document(root / "index.json", index_sha256)
    paths = {}
    for block in index["blocks"]:
        safe_name(block["path"])
        manifest = document(root / block["path"], block["manifest_sha256"])
        for row in manifest["samples"]:
            safe_name(row["path"])
            paths[row["sha256"]] = (root / block["path"]).parent / row["path"]
    if out.exists() or any(p.is_symlink() for p in (out, *out.parents)):
        raise FileExistsError("timing output exists or uses symlink")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    # Reserve the full tensor; generated JPEGs also remain in simulation/.
    used = 480 * ROW_BYTES
    rows = []

    def publish(row, path, *, simulated=False):
        nonlocal used
        deadline()
        data = read_bytes(path, row["sha256"], row["size"])
        name = f"jpeg/{row['sha256']}.jpg"
        target = out / name
        target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        used += len(data) * (2 if simulated else 1)
        if used > MAX_OUTPUT:
            raise ValueError("timing output budget exceeded")
        with target.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
        rows.append({**row, "path": name})

    for row in selected:
        publish(row, paths[row["sha256"]])
    for original in originals:
        deadline()
        safe_name(original["path"])
        data = read_bytes(
            bows / original["path"], original["sha256"], original["bytes"], maximum=1024**2
        )
        generated = generator(data, out / "simulation" / original["lineage"], original["lineage"])
        if not isinstance(generated, list) or len(generated) != 6:
            raise ValueError("timing worker must return six rows")
        for row in generated:
            if (
                row.get("source_group") != "BOWS2"
                or row.get("lineage") != original["lineage"]
                or row.get("split") != "train"
                or row.get("payload_unit") != "bpnzAC"
                or row.get("payload_rate") != (None if row.get("label") == "cover" else 0.2)
                or type(row.get("coefficient_changes")) is not int
                or row["coefficient_changes"] < (0 if row.get("label") == "cover" else 1)
            ):
                raise ValueError("timing worker recipe mismatch")
            safe_name(row.get("path"))
            if Path(row["path"]).parts[0] != original["lineage"]:
                raise ValueError("timing worker lineage path mismatch")
            publish(
                {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "values"},
                out / "simulation" / row["path"],
                simulated=True,
            )
        _buckets(generated, row_limit=6)
        if {r.get("quality_factor") for r in generated} != {75, 95}:
            raise ValueError("timing worker quality mismatch")
    if len(rows) != 480 or len({r["sha256"] for r in rows}) != 480:
        raise ValueError("timing complete unique row accounting failed")
    batches, schedule = srnet_diversity_sampling.epoch_batches(rows, seed=SEED, epoch=0)
    if len(batches) != 192:
        raise ValueError("timing schedule accounting failed")
    tensor_sha = hashlib.sha256()
    geometry: list[dict] = []
    with (out / "pixels.f32").open("xb") as stream:
        for start in range(0, len(rows), 4):
            deadline()
            group = rows[start : start + 4]
            files = [read_bytes(out / r["path"], r["sha256"], r["size"]) for r in group]
            tensor = jpeg_float256.pixel_batch(files)
            raw = tensor.astype("<f4", copy=False).tobytes()
            if len(raw) != len(group) * ROW_BYTES or not np.isfinite(tensor).all():
                raise ValueError("timing decoder output mismatch")
            stream.write(raw)
            tensor_sha.update(raw)
            geometry.extend(jpeg_float256.region(data) for data in files)
    manifest = {
        "schema_version": "jpeg-real-timing-kit-v1",
        "status": "completed",
        "protocol_sha256": protocol_sha256,
        "inputs": binding,
        "samples": rows,
        "bows_originals": originals,
        "shape": [480, 1, 256, 256],
        "dtype": "<f4",
        "tensor_bytes": 480 * ROW_BYTES,
        "tensor_sha256": tensor_sha.hexdigest(),
        "decoder": jpeg_float256.decoder_contract(),
        "geometry": geometry,
        "schedule": schedule,
        "purpose": "train-only GPU timing, not accuracy evaluation",
        "full_corpus_optimizer_updates_per_epoch": 4932,
        "model_trained": False,
        "accuracy_qualification": "unavailable",
        "deployed": False,
        "redistribution": "private local use only; source licenses unchanged",
    }
    deadline()
    digest = write_document(out / "manifest.json", manifest)
    return {
        "status": "completed",
        "manifest_sha256": digest,
        "jpeg_rows": len(rows),
        "originals": 96,
        "timing_updates": len(batches),
        "tensor_bytes": 480 * ROW_BYTES,
        "real_model_trained": False,
        "accuracy_qualification": "unavailable",
    }

core/jpeg_timing_probe.py.utf8:
"""Audited train-only real-I/O CUDA timing; no model publication or scoring."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
import time

import numpy as np

from core import jpeg_float256, jpeg_timing, srnet_cuda, srnet_diversity_sampling, srnet_training
from core.srnet_stream import ROW_BYTES, deadline_after, document, regular_open, signature

UPDATES = 66
DISCARD = 18
MAX_SECONDS = 180
MANIFEST_SHA = "53af09292d57f4ddba383060452a21979f00028a9938af3a86ccdf4372d136ca"
AUDIT_SHA = "9df6fed4383fe9d84717c3c1edb145160a4e0c44fbeb3114a9c2a253a3b7d7bb"


class TimingReader:
    """Own one verified 120 MiB file; fetch <=4 rows, never mmap whole corpus."""

    def __init__(self, root, audit, *, deadline):
        self.stream = None
        self.deadline = deadline
        self.max_batch_bytes = 0
        deadline()
        manifest = document(root / "manifest.json", MANIFEST_SHA)
        proof = document(audit, AUDIT_SHA)
        if (
            manifest.get("schema_version") != "jpeg-real-timing-kit-v1"
            or manifest.get("status") != "completed"
            or proof.get("schema_version") != "jpeg-real-timing-independent-audit-v1"
            or proof.get("status") != "completed"
            or proof.get("manifest_sha256") != MANIFEST_SHA
            or proof.get("protocol_sha256") != manifest.get("protocol_sha256")
            or proof.get("independent_IDCT_rows") != 480
            or proof.get("validation_pixels_read") != 0
            or manifest.get("shape") != [480, 1, 256, 256]
            or manifest.get("dtype") != "<f4"
            or manifest.get("tensor_bytes") != 480 * ROW_BYTES
        ):
            raise ValueError("timing requires complete bound independent kit audit")
        self.samples = manifest["samples"]
        if len(self.samples) != 480 or {r["source_group"] for r in self.samples} != set(
            jpeg_timing.ORIGINS
        ):
            raise ValueError("timing complete source accounting mismatch")
        batches, schedule = srnet_diversity_sampling.epoch_batches(
            self.samples, seed=jpeg_timing.SEED, epoch=0
        )
        if schedule != manifest.get("schedule") or len(batches) != 192:
            raise ValueError("timing schedule binding mismatch")
        self.batches = batches[:UPDATES]
        for row in self.samples:
            deadline()
            if row["path"] != f"jpeg/{row['sha256']}.jpg":
                raise ValueError("timing JPEG name mismatch")
            jpeg_timing.read_bytes(root / row["path"], row["sha256"], row["size"])
        self.tensor_sha = manifest["tensor_sha256"]
        self.stream = regular_open(root / "pixels.f32")
        try:
            self.initial = signature(self.stream)
            if self.initial[2] != 480 * ROW_BYTES:
                raise ValueError("timing tensor byte accounting mismatch")
            self.verify()
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def verify(self):
        self.deadline()
        if self.stream is None or signature(self.stream) != self.initial:
            raise ValueError("timing tensor closed or mutated")
        self.stream.seek(0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        while raw := self.stream.read(1024**2):
            self.deadline()
            values = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype="<f4")
            if not np.isfinite(values).all() or np.any(
                np.abs(values) > jpeg_float256.MAX_MAGNITUDE
            ):
                raise ValueError("timing tensor invalid values")
            digest.update(raw)
        if digest.hexdigest() != self.tensor_sha or signature(self.stream) != self.initial:
            raise ValueError("timing tensor identity mismatch")

    def batch(self, indices):
        self.deadline()
        if (
            self.stream is None
            or signature(self.stream) != self.initial
            or not isinstance(indices, np.ndarray)
            or indices.dtype.kind not in "iu"
            or indices.shape != (4,)
            or np.any(indices < 0)
            or np.any(indices >= 480)
        ):
            raise ValueError("timing batch or tensor state outside bounds")
        result = np.empty((4, 1, 256, 256), dtype="<f4")
        for target, index in zip(result, indices, strict=True):
            self.deadline()
            self.stream.seek(int(index) * ROW_BYTES)
            raw = self.stream.read(ROW_BYTES)
            if len(raw) != ROW_BYTES or signature(self.stream) != self.initial:
                raise ValueError("timing row truncated or mutated")
            target[:] = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype="<f4").reshape(1, 256, 256)
        self.max_batch_bytes = max(self.max_batch_bytes, result.nbytes)
        return result

    def close(self):
        if self.stream is not None:
            self.stream.close()
            self.stream = None

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.close()


def projection(intervals):
    """Fixed warmed p95-based per-epoch estimate; never a duration guarantee."""
    if (
        not isinstance(intervals, list)
        or len(intervals) != UPDATES - 1 - DISCARD
        or any(type(v) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(v) or v <= 0 for v in intervals)
    ):
        raise ValueError("real timing requires 47 positive finite warmed intervals")
    median, p95 = float(np.median(intervals)), float(np.quantile(intervals, 0.95))
    estimate = p95 * 4932 * 1.25
    if not math.isfinite(estimate):
        raise ValueError("real timing projection overflow")
    return {
        "full_corpus_updates_per_epoch": 4932,
        "median_update_seconds": median,
        "p95_update_seconds": p95,
        "safety_factor": 1.25,
        "estimated_optimizer_seconds_per_epoch": estimate,
        "estimate_only": True,
        "excluded": ["startup", "upload", "validation", "checkpoint", "disk_charges"],
        "full_corpus_reader_integrated": False,
    }


def profile(root, audit):
    # Fail before touching real data on non-CUDA hosts; never silently run CPU.
    execution = srnet_cuda.inspect()
    import torch

    deadline = deadline_after(MAX_SECONDS)
    started = time.monotonic()
    with TimingReader(root, audit, deadline=deadline) as reader:
        ready_seconds = time.monotonic() - started
        starts: list[float] = []

        def fetch(indices):
            starts.append(time.monotonic())
            return reader.batch(indices)

        _, records = srnet_training._learn(
            fetch=fetch,
            batches=lambda _: reader.batches,
            epochs=1,
            seed=jpeg_timing.SEED,
            params=srnet_training.settings({"max_seconds": MAX_SECONDS}),
            target_pairs=2,
            outer_deadline=deadline,
            device="cuda:0",
        )
        if len(starts) != UPDATES or len(records) != 1 or records[0]["updates"] != UPDATES:
            raise ValueError("real timing optimizer accounting incomplete")
        reader.verify()
        deadline()
        intervals = np.diff(starts)[DISCARD:].tolist()
        return {
            "execution": execution,
            "manifest_sha256": MANIFEST_SHA,
            "audit_sha256": AUDIT_SHA,
            "real_optimizer_updates": UPDATES,
            "discarded_initial_intervals": DISCARD,
            "steady_intervals_seconds": intervals,
            "projection": projection(intervals),
            "input_verification_seconds": ready_seconds,
            "seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
            "max_fetch_bytes": reader.max_batch_bytes,
            "process_peak_gpu_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(0),
            "process_peak_gpu_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(0),
            "real_data_used": True,
            "real_model_trained": True,
            "optimizer_state": "timing-only, discarded; no weights/checkpoints written",
            "production_model_trained": False,
            "io_regime": (
                "verified small cache, likely warm OS cache; full-corpus cold I/O unmeasured"
            ),
            "accuracy_qualification": "unavailable",
            "deployed": False,
        }
